The iron-titanium oxides, now greatly altered to maghaemite and haematite, were titanomagnetites in which the level of original hgh temperature deuteric oxidation was generally low. The majority of samples examined in reflected light with oil immersion exhibit relict titanomagnetite dominated by oxidation classes 1 to 3 as defined by Wilson & Hagg
